scenarios.name: fx-dry-tap
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page (button 5), no turns, one Trig 1 tap (0.3 s hold). Reference for the FX scenarios. The ColdFire runs about 132M instructions per audio second.

scenarios.name: fx-br-32
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 1 (A = Bit Reduction) by +1 detent 32 times (1M instructions apart), then hold Trig 1 for 1.5 s and record 1.5 s of release.

scenarios.name: fx-br-64
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 1 (A = Bit Reduction) by +1 detent 64 times (1M instructions apart), then hold Trig 1 for 1.5 s and record 1.5 s of release.

scenarios.name: fx-br-127
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 1 (A = Bit Reduction) by +1 detent 127 times (1M instructions apart), then hold Trig 1 for 1.5 s and record 1.5 s of release.

scenarios.name: fx-del-64
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 5 (E = Delay send) by +1 detent 64 times (1M instructions apart), then one Trig 1 tap (0.3 s hold) and 3 s of tail.

scenarios.name: fx-del-127
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 5 (E = Delay send) by +1 detent 127 times (1M instructions apart), then one Trig 1 tap (0.3 s hold) and 3 s of tail.

scenarios.name: fx-rev-127
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 6 (F = Reverb send) by +1 detent 127 times (1M instructions apart), then one Trig 1 tap (0.3 s hold) and 3 s of tail.

scenarios.name: fx-chr-127
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 7 (G = Chorus send) by +1 detent 127 times (1M instructions apart), then one Trig 1 tap (0.3 s hold) and 3 s of tail.

scenarios.name: fx-over-127
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 2 (OVER = Overdrive) by +1 detent 127 times (1M instructions apart), then one Trig 1 tap (0.3 s hold) and 3 s of tail.

scenarios.name: fx-srr-127
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 3 (SRR) by +1 detent 127 times (1M instructions apart), then one Trig 1 tap (0.3 s hold) and 3 s of tail.

scenarios.name: fx-del-turnmore
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 5 (Delay send) by +4 detents 150 times (600 detents, 1M instructions apart) to reach its maximum, then one Trig 1 tap (0.3 s hold) and 4 s of tail.

scenarios.name: fx-del-hold
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 5 (Delay send) by +4 detents 150 times to its maximum, then hold Trig 1 for 2 s and record 2 s of tail.

scenarios.name: fx-dry-hold
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, no turns, hold Trig 1 for 2 s and record 2 s of tail. Reference for fx-del-hold.

scenarios.name: fx-dmp-del
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 5 (Delay send) +4 detents 150 times to its maximum, then hold Trig 1 to the end of the run (about 1 s into the note). Same event times in fx-dmp-del, -rev, -dry so `--dump-dsp` states are at the same instruction count (tools/dspdiff.py).

scenarios.name: fx-dmp-rev
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 6 (Reverb send) +4 detents 150 times to its maximum, then hold Trig 1 to the end of the run (about 1 s into the note). Same event times in fx-dmp-del, -rev, -dry so `--dump-dsp` states are at the same instruction count (tools/dspdiff.py).

scenarios.name: fx-dmp-dry
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 5 +4 detents 75 times then -4 detents 75 times (ends at 0), then hold Trig 1 to the end of the run (about 1 s into the note). Same event times in fx-dmp-del, -rev, -dry so `--dump-dsp` states are at the same instruction count (tools/dspdiff.py).

scenarios.name: fx-dmp-chr
scenarios.description: DN2: open the track FX page, turn encoder 7 (Chorus send) +4 detents 150 times to its maximum, then hold Trig 1 to the end of the run (about 1 s into the note). Same event times in fx-dmp-del, -chr, -dry so `--dump-dsp` states are at the same instruction count (tools/dspdiff.py).
